{{Quote|I wish he wouldn't shoot paying customers|The bartender referring to Kyle Katarn|audio=BaronsHedBartender-PayingCustomers.flac|<ref name="DF2" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] lived on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Sulon/Legends|Sulon]] during the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], where he [[Bartender/Legends|operated]] a small [[Cantina/Legends|tavern]] located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Barons Hed]]. At some point, the [[Barons Hed tavern|establishment]] entertained five members of the [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Species/Legends|species]], who were all [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]]. Their visit turned into a brawl, as the Gran were unable decide who was going to pay the bill. The brawl ended when the the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Initiate]] [[Kyle Katarn]] entered the bar and [[Death/Legends|slew]] the Gran, displeasing the bartender given that all of his customers were killed.

==Biography==
{{Quote|No, Shmorg, I've got it.|A Gran offers to buy drinks, as opposed to Shmorg, which prompts a brawl in the bartender's tavern|<ref name="DFG">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II: The Official Strategy Guide]]''</ref>}}
During the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]],<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]'' to [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]].</ref> a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bartender/Legends|operated]] a [[Cantina/Legends|tavern]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Barons Hed]], located on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Sulon/Legends|Sulon]]. During this [[Time/Legends|time]], the city was under the control of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and became a haven for Imperial [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]]. At some point, five [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] bounty hunters entered the man's [[Barons Hed tavern|establishment]]<ref name="DF2" /> for a round of drinks. When the time came to [[Currency/Legends|pay]] for the beverages, the Gran named [[Shmorg]] offered to pay for the entire tab. However, a [[Unidentified Gran (Barons Hed)|different Gran]] offered to pay for the drinks instead. The resulting confusion of who was going to pay for the drinks ultimately led to an [[Unarmed combat/Legends|unarmed brawl]],<ref name="DFG" /> and the bartender frantically called for the Gran to not use [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] inside his tavern. As the fight broke out, the bartender hurriedly ran around behind his bar table<ref name="DF2" /> as two of the Gran were beaten to [[Death/Legends|death]].<ref name="DFG" />
[[File:Barons_Hed_Bar.png|thumb|left|225px|The bartender's establishment in Barons Hed]]
{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
Moments after the brawl broke out, the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Initiate]] [[Kyle Katarn]], who was in Barons Hed to [[Mission to Sulon|disrupt]] Imperial activities, entered the bar. Using the weapons he had on hand, Katarn slew the remaining Gran when they tried to attack him. The bartender, none to happy with the fact that his paying customers were all lying dead on the floor, gruffly noted that he did not appreciate Katarn's antics. Katarn left shortly after, but not before ransacking the tavern of its [[Personal energy shield/Legends|personal energy shields]].<ref name="DF2" /><ref name="DFG" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|No blasters! No blasters!|The bartender calling for the Gran to refrain from blaster usage|audio=BaronsHedBartender-NoBlasters.flac|<ref name="DF2" />}}
A [[Color/Legends|gray]]-[[Hair/Legends|haired]] Human with black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], the bartender did not like at least two things on the day of Katarn's visit: Customers shooting up his bar, and people shooting up his customers. When Katarn finished his work with the Gran, the bartender made his distaste for Katarn's killings clear, but did not attempt to stop Katarn from taking his shield units free of charge. During the fight in his bar. the bartender frantically ran around in circles behind his bar table, and made his wish for the Gran not to use blasters loud and clear. However, none of the Gran were actually armed with blasters. The man also had light colored skin.<ref name="DF2" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|In any case, if Gran are stupid enough to kill each other, be smart enough to let them.|Rick Barba, author of the ''Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II'' strategy guide, describes the bar brawl|<ref name="DFG" />}}
The bartender first appeared in the [[1997]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]'', and appeared in the game's fifth level.<ref name="DF2" /> He also received a mention in the game's [[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II: The Official Strategy Guide|official strategy guide]].<ref name="DFG" /> The brawl in his tavern is initiated when the player nears the building, but since the event does not effect the story or outcome of the level in any way, the tavern encounter can be completely skipped without effect.<ref name="DF2" /><ref name="DFG" /> The bartender's voice actor was uncredited.
